display_long_description:
Welcome to PolarChaseVR! ❄️

PolarChaseVR is a Multiplayer game where you can explore the Backrooms, face monsters like Captain Clark and the Bacteria, survive scary Horror Mode levels, build in Sandbox, climb in Only Up, test your luck in Russian Roulette, and customize your character with awesome cosmetics and mods!

📅 **WEEKLY UPDATES**
PolarChaseVR gets **new updates every week!** Expect new game modes, maps, cosmetics, features, seasonal events, and more!

👹 **THE BACKROOMS**
Enter the Backrooms and explore strange levels while trying to survive monsters like **Captain Clark, the Bacteria, and more!**

😱 **HORROR MODE**
Explore multiple terrifying levels filled with monsters, creepy environments, and challenges. How far can you make it?

🧱 **SANDBOX MODE**
Build whatever you can imagine! Create houses, towers, maps, traps, and more.

⬆️ **ONLY UP**
Climb higher and higher without falling. One mistake could send you all the way back down!

🔫 **RUSSIAN ROULETTE**
Test your luck against your friends and see who comes out on top!

🛍️ **THE SHOP**
Customize your character with awesome cosmetics, mods, and other fun items!
